comparison.objective: Compress both legs of a cage fastener, insert its hooks through a rack opening, and release it to retain.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual spring-leg compression, square-hole alignment, insertion, and controlled release behind a panel.
comparison.success_condition: Both legs must have been compressed together during passage, hooks must retain behind the coupon, and the fastener must be seated with the fixture undisturbed.
comparison.reason: This is insertion and release of a whole spring fastener. The candidate instead inserts a separate dual-blade tool around a recessed contact, holds two tangs released, and extracts by the wire.
